text_block_list.text:
On my way out after staying late for work,
I sensed a presence in a nearby classroom,
and peeked inside—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Thank goodness.
It's just you, Trainer.
choice_data_list: What are you two doing?
What are you two doing?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
P-Patrol duty, sir!
I am just making my rounds to ensure there are no anomalies...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I'm just keeping Fenomeno company.
There's no rule saying patrolling has to be done alone, is there?
choice_data_list: The school building is dark at night, so... I'll come with you.
The school building is dark at night, so... I'll come with you.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Really? That's so reassuring!
And so, I ended up patrolling the academy at night with the two of them. In stark contrast to the daytime bustle, the nighttime hallways were dead silent...
choice_data_list: ...That's kinda creepy.
...That's kinda eerie, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...See? The air feels colder than usual.
Is it... because there's no one around?
(Rattle, rattle, rattle!!)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: !? W-What was that just now?!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
“—It's okay, it's just the wind.
Haha, it was pretty sudden, so it startled you, didn't it?”

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that so...?
My apologies, that movie earlier just came to mind, and I couldn't help myself...
choice_data_list: That movie from earlier?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I was watching it with everyone in the dorm until just now.
It was, well, kinda scary—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"—Man, that had some serious impact.
Especially when the window shattered and that woman slithered in..."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
P-Please stop!
That "slitherrr~" was the scariest part!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, my bad, my bad!
I'll come along on your patrol to make up for it.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"...Looking back, it was thoughtless of me.
No matter how curious I was, doing something like that when I knew there would be patrols..."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
It can't be helped. The detective protagonist was so cool.
I was curious about the ending too, so I ended up watching it—
Kyaaaaaah!!
choice_data_list: What was that just now... a scream!?

text_block_list.text: (Slip... slip...)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ââ!! You two, look at that...!

Looking where she pointed, a dark silhouette on all fours
emerged from the end of the hallway.
The shadow slowly crept closer to us...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Ah, aaah, what on earth is that...!?
choice_data_list: I don't know what's going on, but we should get away...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
――...Wait.
That feeling, could it be...?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —You two, fall back!
choice_data_list: Bubble!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Kuh, what kind of weakness am I showing... ngh.
—Bubble-san, me too!
choice_data_list: Wait, both of you, don't do anything dangerous—!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
――!
Are you okay!? Can you hear me?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: !! That person over there is...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it looks like they're injured.
It's dark, though, so I can't tell for sure.

When I rushed to the scene and looked closely,
I saw one of the academy's teachers there.
It seemed they were unable to stand or walk.

text_block_list.name: Math Teacher
text_block_list.text:
...I went back to get something I forgot,
and then fell down the stairs... Urgh...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"We'll support her.
Trainer, could you call an ambulance?"
choice_data_list: Yeah!
Yeah!

text_block_list.text:
Afterward, accompanied by Tracen Academy staff who rushed over upon hearing the commotion,
the teacher was transported to the hospital by ambulance.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: She was taken to the hospital just in case, but—according to the paramedics, it's nothing serious. I suppose that settles the matter for now.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. That's good.
......Phew~~.
choice_data_list: Bubble?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Sorry,
I just kind of lost my steam for a second.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: "Me as well... The situation earlier was rather frightening until I realized it was you, Sensei..."
choice_data_list: Even so, you still managed to start running. Impressive.
Even so, it's amazing you were able to start running.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
It's not like I wasn't scared. But,
I thought, "Someone might be in trouble."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Then—"we have to go check it out," right?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Bubble-san... Not letting fear stop your feet, and running just in case the worst happens—
I am in awe of your dedication!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Even Fenomeno followed after me
and came here, didn't she?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Of course, sir!
I couldn't possibly leave you alone in a situation like that!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...I love that about you.
That strength of yours to leap in with courage for someone else's sake.
choice_data_list: You two really are similar in some ways.
You two really are similar in some ways.
You were both so brave!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...I love that about you.
That strength of yours to leap in with courage for someone else's sake.
choice_data_list: You two really are similar in some ways.
You two really are similar in some ways.
You were both so brave!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Ha, I am humbled!
However, as someone who enforces justice,
I still have much to learn from Bubble-san's courage!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you! Hearing you say that
makes me feel a little ticklish inside.

Bubble Gum Fellow blushes slightly at Fenomeno's sparkling, wide-eyed gaze.
It was truly a heartwarming sight to behold.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: You're calling me "brave"? Haha, that's kind of embarrassing... but it makes me happy.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Always ready to dive in headfirst—
that's the kind of person I want to keep being.
